ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65 high-intensity (white) to 0.35 low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity white contiguous regions occupying the distal two-thirds of each lobe; the left lobe white region contains multiple dark diagonal streaks; the right lobe white region contains a distinct vertical dark line and mottled dark spots at the tip; the central junction is a low-intensity black region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with low pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge; distal tips exhibit increased jaggedness and smaller-scale topographical peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slight concave transition from the median notch leading into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips and inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive dark linear markings (rake marks) oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge, distributed across the white pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular trailing edge profile and minor notches at the distal tips, indicating historical tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct yellowish-brown chromatic shading visible on the proximal interior margins of the white pigmentation patches.
